questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The heading 'Where do you want your listing to appear?' asks about placement, not the outcome the seller wants (more buyers/chats); the job has to be inferred.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Start Spotlight' is the only filled button.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The '80' and '40' coin steppers don't say they're a price per click; only the coin icon hints at it.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '2nd-price', '2× standard' and 'slots' appear with no explanation for a casual seller.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Asks for two separate per-click prices (Premium 80, Standard 40) before the seller has any basis for what a click is worth.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The pricing-mechanics paragraph ('Premium starts at 2× standard… You pay 2nd-price…') sits open under the cards.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Two-tier bidding is advertiser-level control; it suits a Pro seller more than the casual seller this flow starts from.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: 'Premium starts at 2× standard and is never cheaper than standard. You pay 2nd-price…' is a 29-word paragraph the seller needs to understand the two prices.
